 News HONOR Play 20A Arrives on Shopee This 11.11 for as Low as PHP 45 a Day

 · 
 November 6, 2026  ·  1 min read

 #Honor 
 #HONOR Play 20A 
 HONOR Philippines is offering the Play 20A exclusively on Shopee this November 11 as part of the 11.11 Mega Pamasko Sale. With a special selling price of PHP 8,099, down from its PHP 8,999 SRP, you can also get the smartphone for as low as PHP 45 per day for six months with 0% interest via SPayLater.
 HONOR Play 20A is on Shopee 
 The phone features a 2-inch Smart Rear Screen that lets you check notifications, control media, and take selfies using the rear camera. It also features a 6.9-inch display with a 90Hz refresh rate for smoother viewing and a 6,000mAh battery for everyday use.
 “We want to make the HONOR Play 20A more accessible to Filipino consumers while giving them more ways to enjoy its features. Through our exclusive Shopee availability this 11.11, customers can take advantage of special pricing, vouchers, and flexible payment options, making it easier to experience a smartphone designed for their everyday needs.” 
 Stephen Cheng, Vice President of HONOR Philippines. 
 Get More Deals This 11.11 on Shopee 
 You can get the Play 20A for PHP 8,099, plus an additional 20% OFF Discount Voucher and free shipping on Shopee. Those who prefer installment payments can also get the device for as low as PHP 45 per day for six months at 0% interest through SPayLater.
 You can also look forward to exclusive discounts, vouchers, and freebies during Shopee Live sessions featuring James Afante on November 10 at 12 noon and Kris Aquino and Bimby Aquino on November 10 at 6 PM. 
 The HONOR Play 20A will be available exclusively on Shopee for early online access on November 11, ahead of its official launch and nationwide availability on November 28, 2026.
 For more information about HONOR Philippines, you may visit their website .
